#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using int64 = long long;
const int MOD = 998244353;

struct Matrix {
    int64 a00, a01, a10, a11;
    Matrix(int64 a00, int64 a01, int64 a10, int64 a11) 
        : a00(a00), a01(a01), a10(a10), a11(a11) {}
    Matrix mul(const Matrix& o) const {
        return Matrix(
            (a00 * o.a00 + a01 * o.a10) % MOD,
            (a00 * o.a01 + a01 * o.a11) % MOD,
            (a10 * o.a00 + a11 * o.a10) % MOD,
            (a10 * o.a01 + a11 * o.a11) % MOD
        );
    }
    Matrix pow(int e) const {
        if (e == 1) return *this;
        Matrix r = pow(e >> 1);
        r = r.mul(r);
        if (e & 1) {
            r = r.mul(*this);
        }
        return r;
    }
};

int64 exp_mod(int64 a, int e) {
    if (e == 1) return a;
    int64 r = exp_mod(a, e >> 1);
    r = r * r % MOD;
    if (e & 1) {
        r = r * a % MOD;
    }
    return r;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    if ((n & 1) && (m & 1)) {
        int64 total = r - l + 1;
        cout << exp_mod(exp_mod(total, n), m) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    int even = r / 2 - (l + 1) / 2 + 1;
    int odd = r - l + 1 - even;
    Matrix base(even, odd, odd, even);
    Matrix pw = base.pow(n).pow(m);
    cout << pw.a00 << "\n";
    return 0;
}
